title: Billing & Recovery
description: Stop losing recurring revenue to failed payments, dunning gaps, and billing errors — recovery playbooks for SaaS and subscriptions.

faq.a: The process of retrying declined charges, emailing customers to update cards, and recovering revenue from involuntary churn — often the highest-ROI billing fix.

faq.q: How quickly should you retry failed payments?
faq.a: Most teams use 3–4 retries over two weeks, plus dunning emails with a one-click update link. Smart retry timing improves recovery rates.

intro: Billing leaks are silent: cards fail, invoices slip, and MRR drops without a cancellation survey. This cluster covers detection and recovery.
